projection.name: consul
projection.title: Consul
projection.description: HashiCorp Consul cockpit: hierarchical KV browsing and editing, catalog services and nodes, health checks, sessions, prepared queries, service-mesh intentions, and ACL tokens, policies, and roles.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: Address of a Consul agent or server HTTP API.

fields.label: Path prefix
fields.help: Set when the HTTP API is served behind a reverse proxy that strips a prefix.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional certificate and private key for mutual TLS.

fields.label: Datacenter
fields.help: Default datacenter for every query. Leave empty to use the agent's own datacenter.

fields.label: Namespace
fields.help: Consul Enterprise namespace applied to every request.

fields.label: Admin partition
fields.help: Consul Enterprise admin partition applied to every request.

fields.label: KV root prefix
fields.help: Root the key browser starts from. Leave empty to browse the whole key space.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks key writes, deregistration, intention changes, and session destruction.

fields.label: Allow stale reads
fields.help: Lets any server answer reads instead of the leader; faster but possibly out of date.

fields.label: Page size
fields.help: Caps rows fetched per page and nodes shown per key-tree level.

fields.label: Key
fields.help: Full key path, for example apps/web/config.

fields.label: Flags
fields.help: Opaque 64-bit marker Consul stores alongside the value.

fields.label: Check-and-set index
fields.help: Write only when the key is still at this modify index. Leave empty for an unconditional write.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected key(s)? The stored value is removed from every Consul server.

actions.label: Delete folder
actions.confirmText: Recursively delete every key under this prefix? The values cannot be recovered.

actions.label: Deregister
actions.confirmText: Deregister the selected instance(s) from the catalog? The node must re-register to appear again.

actions.label: Destroy
actions.confirmText: Destroy the selected session(s)? Locks held by them are released or their keys deleted.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected intention(s)? Traffic then falls back to the default mesh policy.
